title: Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (SIAM), Auto Industry Performance of August 2026, 15 September 2026
note: SIAM reports August 2026 production of 3,157,822 units across covered categories; domestic sales included 439,309 passenger vehicles, 93,764 three-wheelers and 2,034,698 two-wheelers. It reports year-on-year growth of 36.5%, 22.8% and 10.5%, respectively, and cautions that the prior-year base was lower.

title: Mahindra & Mahindra, Results Q4 F26 and FY26, 5 May 2026
note: M&M reported FY26 consolidated revenue of Rs 198,639 crore (+25%) and consolidated PAT of Rs 17,099 crore; its release reports FY26 auto volumes up 19% and UV volumes up 20%. Figures are company-reported and definitions in the release should be consulted.

note: Reuters reports Hyundai Motor Group's announced $15.5 billion India investment through 2032, including R&D and capacity-related investment, underscoring competition and localization.

title: Reuters, Indian firms seen posting faster profit growth despite global headwinds, 8 October 2026
note: Reuters summarizes brokerage expectations of stronger September-quarter earnings growth but also notes demand uncertainties and possible commodity-cost pressure. This is a forecast summary, not a confirmed earnings result.

title: Reuters, India steel ministry unlikely to seek new curbs on cheap imports, 7 October 2026
note: Reuters discusses steel import and pricing conditions as a potential input-cost and margin factor for steel consumers, including automotive manufacturers.

title: Yahoo Finance public historical market data interface (accessed at run time)
note: Historical price data are retrieved programmatically via yfinance. Availability, corporate actions, index symbol conventions and adjustments depend on the source. The script records the actual download window and latest observation.

title: Nifty Indices, Nifty Auto index overview and methodology
note: Nifty Auto is an Indian automotive-sector index calculated using free-float market capitalization. This report does not calculate historical official-index returns because Yahoo returned only one usable observation for its ^CNXAUTO symbol in this run; instead it uses a clearly labeled equally weighted basket of the included stock sample.
